Claim: PM loop round 3 (item 2 of objectui#12211, as triage `6121957396` directs on the parent: the console's assistant button no longer covers the inline-edit save and the attachment delete controls at common viewports, and attachment delete asks through the console's ordinary destructive-action confirm; ⛔ no new setting)
Session: `session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`
Account: `os-warren`
Branch: `claude/issue-12248-fab-yields-attachment-confirm`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12248`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface, on objectui `main` `7578323a`:
- **The button:** `packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleChatbotFab.tsx` (`fixed bottom-20 right-6`, `sm:bottom-6`). It yields while an inline-edit save bar or a bottom-right row action occupies its corner; the mechanism (a shell-level signal, an inset, or hiding) is the dev's, measured.
- **The save bar,** only where it must signal or clear the corner: `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineEditSaveBar.tsx`.
- **The attachment delete:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`. The row's delete goes through `ActionConfirmDialog` (`views/ActionConfirmDialog.tsx`, read and reused, ⛔ not changed), the confirm the record page's own delete uses (objectui#11001).
- **Strings:** `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, all ten packs, only if no existing key says "delete this attachment" truly. An existing key that names a different noun is ⛔ not reused.
- Co-located tests, and `.changeset/12248-fab-yields-attachment-confirm.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`; `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/i18n` if touched; ⛔ never `major`).
- ⛔ No new setting, prop on a published component, or spec key.
- (Stop on breach; explain in the report.)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: `objectui's console shell (@object-ui/app-shell ConsoleChatbotFab), whose fixed bottom-right button sits over the record page's inline-edit save bar and the attachments panel's delete; and RecordAttachmentsPanel, whose delete calls dataSource.delete at once | the record page's own delete already asks through ActionConfirmDialog (objectui#11001) | every user editing a record inline or deleting an attachment at 1440-wide viewports (measured in the parent's 2026-10-12 hosted pass on HotCRM 4.0.1: elementFromPoint at the centre of 保存 and 删除附件 returned the assistant button; one tester lost an inline save; DELETE sys_attachment answered 200 with no confirm)`
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-12T14:01Z on objectui `main` `7578323a`:
- **The files:** their last changes on `main` (`023f00d4`, `9b6c19ef`) have landed. No open PR touches `ConsoleChatbotFab.tsx`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`, `ActionConfirmDialog.tsx` or `InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` (8 open PRs read).
- **Neighbours:** this seat's open PRs objectui#12259 (`plugin-detail` feed files) and objectui#12260 (`console/home`, `layout/InboxPopover.tsx`, new `layout/ActivityObjectLabel.tsx`) share no file. `Clause-②: yes` is declared up front for the likely pack key; if the dev measures an existing key that fits, the report narrows it to `no` and says why.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#12264 (head `50d6a6f`) · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd` · 2026-10-12T15:32Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the diff, not the report. Inputs: claim `6125835635` and report `6126936166`.

- **Shape:**
  - Draft on `main`. The first line is `Fixes #12248`, and the parent objectui#12211 is named bare.
  - `Clause-②: yes`, as the claim declared up front for the pack key.
  - The files are inside the claimed surface. One more is a co-located i18n pin: `de-quote-pairing-3876`'s pinned count moves with the new German pair.
  - `check-governed-merges --pr` reads NOT governed.
- **The fix:** read against the diff.
  - `ConsoleChatbotFab` goes `invisible` while an element marked `data-fab-yield` overlaps its own box. It re-measures once per frame on scroll, resize and node changes.
  - `InlineEditSaveBar` and the attachments panel's row actions carry the marker.
  - The attachment delete asks through the unchanged `ActionConfirmDialog` (`destructive`), the record page's own confirm. Cancel deletes nothing.
  - One pack key, `detail.deleteAttachmentConfirm`, is added to all ten packs. ⛔ No setting, prop, export or spec key.
- **Contract review: PASS** `6127380179` on this head. Two non-blocking notes, both taken as Acceptance notes below.
- **Evidence:**
  - A browser before/after at 1440×900, 1440×1400, 1280×720 and 1920×1080, in en and zh: `elementFromPoint` returns Save and Delete, not the assistant button. At 390×844 the button stays visible, because the bar sits below it.
  - 4 ablation legs, each red as pre-registered, restore proven.
  - CI on `50d6a6f` reads 30 success and 3 skipped.
- **Acceptance notes:**
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` are scored `patch` for an additive change. The truthful word is `minor`, but the published version does not move, because all objectui packages are one `fixed` group (contract review ②). Left as is.
  - `data-fab-yield` is a thin published contract, read across two packages. It is stated in the changeset and the source comments; a README line would make it durable. Not filed: under the filing gate a missing doc line is not a card. `carrier:` the next card that touches `InlineEditSaveBar`'s docs.
  - The console stylesheet's unlayered `button:not([disabled])` transition rule overrides Tailwind `transition-*` utilities on buttons. Polish, outside the three classes. Acceptance notes, `carrier:` none.
  - The yield is opt-in. No other bottom-right control was measured under the button. An inference, not a finding.
- **Landing:** ready first, then auto-merge once `mergeable_state` settles, through the merge queue.
